title: bro_exec task-completed signal emission
wanted_capability: `bro_exec` must emit a `task-completed` signal (correlatable by task_id) on terminal state so routing packets with `route: signal_arc` can fire automatically.
notes: Auto-digest-arc's routing packet exists but never fires because `bro_exec` doesn't emit the signal. Operator triggers manually via `bbox_orchestrate_run`.
resolution_note: Capability exists in full and is live-verified (2026-07-14, beta/blackbox-v2, isolated daemon). Two delivery lanes: (1) every task terminal state emits a hub SystemEvent task.completed/.failed/.cancelled with correlation {task_id} (orchestration/mod.rs wait-loop terminal emit), and spawn_system_event_signal_bridge (server/background.rs) resolves any pending workflow wait whose signal matches by correlation via signal_arc_dispatch; (2) spawn_task_completed_router routes TailEvent::TaskCompleted through domain:auto-digest/task-completed-routing for packet-driven start_arc routing (entity carries task_id/session_id/task_kind). Live probe: an arc dispatched a bro via mcp_call bro_exec, stashed taskId, registered waits on task.completed/task.failed with correlate {task_id: vars.bg_task_id}, and the bridge resolved the wait on bro completion (wait_registered → wait_resolved → arc completed). Workflows can wait on external bro task completion today with no shell polling.
